name: Naldar
description: Naldar was an Outer Rim world in the Phelleem sector. During the Galactic Civil War, Naldar became the target of severe Imperial aggression, withstanding a 2 ABY offensive that killed most of the royal family, and a 4 ABY another Imperial attack subjugated the world. However, Princess Vila, the royal family's sole survivor, returned with an Alliance of Free Planets force that ended the Imperial threat on Naldar.
lead_paragraphs: Naldar was an Outer Rim world in the Phelleem sector.
